name: SparePartsIllustratedCatalogue
tagline: Interactive exploded views that turn callouts into orders.
description: An illustrated parts catalogue PCF control for OEM and dealer parts portals: exploded-view drawings with clickable callouts linked to the parts list, assembly tree, serial-number applicability, supersession chains, kits, stock and price, and an order list that produces a quote request. Works in Power Pages, Canvas and Model-driven apps.
features: Exploded-view drawings from JSON shapes or your own image, with numbered callouts and leader lines
Two-way callout ↔ parts-list highlighting, zoom and pan
Assembly tree and breadcrumbs with drill-down into sub-assemblies
Supersession chains (interchangeable / one-way) – always orders the current part
Kits, critical parts and fitting notes
Search across assemblies including superseding part numbers
Order list with PO reference validation and quote request output
Phone layout with Diagram / Parts / Order tabs
Browse-only and read-only modes, configurable labels and accent
